origin: Original deterministic integer PCM from generate_audio.c; offline-encoded
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 8.1.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
commands: ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -f s16le -ar 44100 -ac 1 -i mono.raw -c:a mp2 -b:a 96k -f mp2 mono.mp2
ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -f s16le -ar 48000 -ac 2 -i stereo.raw -c:a mp2 -b:a 192k -f mp2 stereo.mp2
ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -f s16le -ar 32000 -ac 1 -i mono.raw -c:a mp2 -b:a 96k -f mp2 mono32.mp2
runtime: reads fixed mp2 bytes; ffmpeg not required
ps: 16 one-audio-frame PES packets, sorted explicit PTS, no video
